description: A deliberately coarse baseline of the Indian coast, expressed as ordered sequences of gazetteer place ids. ORCA interpolates between them to estimate distance-to-coast and to derive maritime-zone BANDS. It is an approximation built from public settlement coordinates, accurate to roughly +/- 10 km. It is NOT the territorial sea baseline notified under the Maritime Zones Act, NOT a survey product, and must never be used for navigation or for any legal determination of maritime limits.
